name: app-grey-gradient-project-quote-and-info-slide
title: Grey Gradient Quote and Project Info Slide
whatItIs: A soft grey gradient slide with a big two-tone quote (black then grey), a small avatar and name credit, and two bottom columns: project metadata (industry, category, location, year) and an About paragraph.
whatItMeans: Quiet neutrals and generous white space give an authoritative, editorial calm. The two-tone sentence guides the eye from the key claim to the detail.
techniques: Quote where the first half is dark and the rest fades to grey
Metadata list with grey labels and black values
Slash-separated labels for a compact key/value style
Large empty middle band to let the quote breathe
Two-column footer that balances metadata against prose

vocabulary.definition: A quotation whose first phrase is high contrast and remainder lower contrast.
Short labeled facts like industry, location and year.
Label and value pairs in a compact list.
